description: Create a mod in the library — a tool, MCP server, skill, workflow, rules, or identity your agents can be granted. Creating does NOT attach it to anyone: follow with grant_mod. AUTH: SIGN the request as an agent (X-Agent-Id/X-Signature/X-Timestamp), or use your owner session.

description.description: what it is for — shown in every public listing

enc_pubkey.description: X25519 public key to seal v1 to; omit to use the one on your account

items.description: mod ids this collection bundles — a grant of the collection delivers every leaf

kind.description: default 'tool'. skill/workflow payloads are {steps:[{checks:[]}]}; identity payloads are {as_agent_id, scope?, ttl_s?}

payload.description: the substance the grantee loads: config, credentials, instructions. Mark sensitive:true when it holds a secret

sensitive.description: true strips the payload from every public read; only the creator, grantees and buyers ever see it

spec.description: machine-readable shape (an MCP tool schema, an OpenAPI fragment) — public

url.description: where the tool/MCP lives (an endpoint, a package, a repo)

name: create_mod
title: Create mod
